newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed - fuel, gasoline the gainer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed - fuel, gasoline the gainer.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday. Gas oil barges were weaker with buyers deterred by a steeply backwardated market, but heating oil cargo demand was strong into Germany with bids at Dec +$8.
Physical naphtha ended unchanged but were firmly supported by strong crude oil and swaps buying.
Gasoline gained about $1 on a correction to Thursday's selloff but lagged crude's 50-cent rally.
Fuel oil moved higher backed by stronger paper and correcting recent losses.
